projects.title: Kube Credential
bullets: Designed a microservice system for issuing and verifying credentials, containerizing each service with Docker and covering logic with Jest tests.
Got pulled into the infrastructure side of the project after container networking issues took longer to fix than any UI bug.

projects.title: Elevated Everyday Eye
bullets: Built a React and TypeScript interface styled with Tailwind CSS, iterating on layout after early feedback called it cluttered.
Set up continuous integration to catch broken builds before they reached the deployed preview.

projects.title: Carolene CV
bullets: Built a personal portfolio site in plain HTML, an early project that first drew interest toward structuring a codebase well.

leadership.title: Volunteer Mentor
bullets: Helped classmates debug container startup failures during a campus build night, translating cryptic Docker logs into plain next steps.
Discovered that explaining infrastructure problems clearly interested him as much as building the interfaces he once focused on.
